name: Patchy
tagline: Scans an AI-built repository for security vulnerabilities and opens one-click fix pull requests.

awards: Vellum: Most Innovative Hack Build with Vellum

problem: AI coding tools ship minimum viable code that is often insecure.
solution: An agent workflow scans the repository, explains vulnerabilities, generates fixes and opens pull requests, with redeploy guidance.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan a project and merge the security fix PR.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Vellum: Most Innovative Hack Build with Vellum” among 131 submissions.
Ends in a pull request, not just a report.

lessons: Security tools that open the fix PR are easier to adopt.
